author: Kevin Kelly
short: Themed owner-only cog and repository management with slash commands.
description: Independently installable presentation layer beside bundled Red Downloader. Themes native replies and supplies checked /download controls for repositories, installation, updates, pinning and revision selection. Keeps the native installation agreement, converters, disabled-command state, dependency reports and reload behavior. Does not replace Downloader or create another package database.
install_msg: Load bundled Downloader, then [p]load downloaderplus. Use [p]download help; enable slash commands with [p]slash enablecog downloaderplus and [p]slash sync. Existing repo/cog commands remain available. Guide: https://github.com/kevinwaynekelly/kevin-cogs/blob/main/downloaderplus/README.md
end_user_data_statement: Stores no persistent settings or member records. Reads and delegates to Red Downloader, whose existing repository, installed-cog and data policies continue to apply. Results go to the invoking channel.
